# Changelog

This add-on is generated from [the Receiver add-on](../ais_catcher) and
carries its changes; see [its changelog](../ais_catcher/CHANGELOG.md).

What is different here is the AIS-catcher it installs: the rolling `Edge`
build rather than a tagged release, which is what makes managed mode
available. `Edge` moves without this add-on changing, so the version
shown for the add-on says nothing about which AIS-catcher is inside it.
The one it started with is the first line AIS-catcher logs.
